answer: Our protocol charges identity creation through a deposit each agent must lock to store a reef of replicated model-state, checked by periodic audits. Honest agents recover it on exit; a Sybil farmer cannot reclaim one deposit across many keys, so N identities cost N deposits plus N audit loops running forever. A pigment of proof-of-replication anchors every key, and any delta in reward goes only to verified storage, so idle fakes bleed rent until the attack price exceeds the payoff.
